name: Morgana
notes: Casts go one at a time: Dark Binding and Tormented Shadow each keep Morgana busy for their 0.25 s cast time (no other cast, no attack starts inside it) and Soul Shackles for its 0.35 s cast time; one `busy_until` tracks this.

Opens with Soul Shackles (R) at t=0, assuming it is available: its huge cooldown (100-120s) means only one cast fits inside a short fight, so this reads as a full-cooldown burst check rather than a sustained-ult scenario.

Soul Shackles' cast starts the tether over its 0.35s cast time and keeps Morgana busy for that long; because the stationary dummy can never break the 3s tether, the identical aftereffect hit and its stun always land automatically 3s after the initial hit. Both hits call the ult's hatefog hook.

Tormented Shadow (W) is cast the instant it is off cooldown (and no other cast is in progress): it deals its on-cast hit plus 9 further ticks every 0.5s (10 hits total, matching the wiki's own '9*10'/'35*10' total-damage math, i.e. ticks at the cast and every 0.5s up to 4.5s later).

The wiki lists two contradictory readings of W's per-tick damage: the tooltip text ('Minimum Damage Per Tick' = half BaseDamage +10% AP, doubling to the full BaseDamage +20% AP at 100% missing health) versus the bin's literal 'TotalMinDamage' (full BaseDamage, no missing-health term) and 'TotalMaxDamage' (that doubled). This kit uses the tooltip reading (half BaseDamage as the 0%-missing floor, doubling at 100% missing) because it alone reproduces both wiki-quoted numeric ranges exactly.
Each W tick's missing-health amplifier is recomputed live against the dummy's current (falling) health at the moment that tick lands, not fixed once at cast.

Every landed Morgana ability hit (Q, each W tick, both R hits) triggers Soul Siphon; here that is modeled as immediately shaving 5% of Tormented Shadow's total (post-haste) cooldown off its live, currently-counting cooldown, per the wiki's explicit note that it can shorten the ability's own cooldown mid-cycle.
If Tormented Shadow comes off cooldown again while its own ticks are still resolving, the new cast simply restarts the 10-tick cycle, since 'damage from multiple Tormented Shadows does not stack.'
Dark Binding (Q) is cast on cooldown throughout the fight for its flat magic damage, waiting for any cast already in progress; its root is crowd control and ignored.
Black Shield (E) is never cast: it deals no damage and only matters in a survival scenario. Soul Siphon's self-heal is likewise not modeled since it doesn't affect the dummy's damage taken.
Morgana still auto-attacks (ranged, base windup 0.14) whenever no cast is pending; her kit has no on-hit, attack-speed, or reset interaction so default attack behavior is used.
Mana is not modeled: nothing here binds inside a 15 s fight at level 16.
